summary.text: Allen Reavis is a Republican state representative from Kansas House District 63 who has represented the district since January 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Allen Reavis earned a graduate degree from the University of Missouri, Kansas City in 1984, and his career experience includes working as a dentist.
He has been affiliated with the Kansas Dental Association, the American Dental Association, St. Benedict's Catholic Church Parish, Boy Scouts and the Community Foundation.
Reavis succeeded John Eplee in the District 63 seat and took office on January 13, 2025. He faces Adam Booth in the general election.
